{{Color box|{{party color|People's Champ Movement}}|border=darkgray}} [[People's Champ Movement|PCM]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Sarangani's at-large congressional district''' is the sole [[congressional district of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Sarangani]]. It was created ahead of the [[1995 Philippine House of Representatives elections]] following the separation of the [[South Cotabato's 3rd congressional district|third district]] from [[South Cotabato]] in 1992.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=7228|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1992/03/16/republic-act-no-7228/ |title=An Act Creating the Province of Sarangani |date=March 16, 1992 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)]] |accessdate=March 4, 2021}} The province has been electing a single representative provincewide [[at-large]] to the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] from the [[10th Congress of the Philippines|10th Congress]] onwards.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 4, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Steve Solon]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP) and [[People's Champ Movement]] (PCM).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 4, 2021}}{{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/php-tpls-attachments/2025NLE/COC_2025NLE/COC_Local/COC_Local_R12/COC_Local_SARANGANI/COC_SARANGANI_OPES_SOLON_STEVE_CHIONGBIAN.pdf|title=COC_SARANGANI_OPES_SOLON_STEVE_CHIONGBIAN|publisher=[[Commission on Elections (Philippines)|Commission on Elections]]|accessdate=November 12, 2024}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable !
